messages:
marta: quick sync — proposing a capacity-based automatic variant fallback that prefers regional compatible variants first, then tiered fallbacks by customer priority. want feedback on API surface + console UX and telemetry needs.

sam: high level — so when primary model is saturated we transparently route to a compatible variant? what are the compatibility rules? latency/cost tradeoffs? :thinking:

alex: exactly. define compatibility as model architecture + tokenizer + semantic parity threshold. fallback chain: primary -> smaller same-arch quantized variant -> nearest-region equivalent -> higher-latency cloud fallback. each step annotated with reason code.

jiang: telemetry requirements: we need per-route counters for attempts/successes, per-tenant fallback rate, p50/p95 latency delta after fallback, and a signal for semantic-regression (we'll run example prompts set). also tag by reason_code (CAPACITY, REGION, QOS).

devon: console UX thoughts: show a live "fallback heatmap" per model showing which variants are accepting spillover and a tenant-level view that highlights when fallbacks increased past SLA thresholds. users should be able to opt-out per-tenant or pin variant.

kim: API hooks — suggest a request header to express consumer preference and constraints, e.g.:
```
X-RW-Fallback: allow; max_latency_ms=250; prefer_region=us-west; semantic_loss_tolerance=0.02
```
Router honors constraints and returns `x-rw-selected-variant` in response. also add `fallback_trace` array in logs for internal tracing.

marta: nice. policy ideas: default policy for self-serve = allow regional fallback then quantized model; enterprise customers get "no-regional-fallback" toggle + tenant-priority slots so we never spill to lower tier by default.

sam: how do we surface cost impact? devs will want per-request cost estimate if we fallback to bigger-sla options. maybe the router returns `estimated_unit_cost` when it picks a variant.

alex: implementation note: router should sample small fraction of traffic on initial fallback to evaluate quality before broad routing. propose regional-sampling config: `sampling_rate_per_variant = 0.02` then ramp to 1.0 if quality metrics look good.

jiang: for sampling we need automated eval hooks — send sampled requests to eval pipeline with golden prompts and compute embedding distance/regression signals. store as timeseries for alerting.

devon: rollout UX — when enabling fallback for a customer show a preview modal: expected latency change, estimated cost delta, and a toggle to allow sampling-only for N hours. add a "revert" button that forces requests back to primary for 30m.

kim: small edge: what about cache / KV state when switching variants? we need to copy or invalidate prefix cache. runtime needs a migration rule: if variant shares kv-keyspace, reuse; else invalidate prefix and mark cold-start increase in telemetry.

marta: agreed — log `cache_migration: reused|invalidated` in the fallback_trace. important for postmortems.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: routing-service v2.4.1 will include `fallback_trace` schema. will deploy to staging at 2024-11-02T03:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

sam: question: how to prevent noisy neighbors? tenant-priority slots idea needs a pre-allocated reserved slot pool per tier. when saturated, we evict best-effort tenants based on policy. need clear console signals before eviction.

alex: plus a soft-slot mode: try to serve in primary with throttling + queued tokens before evicting to fallback. that preserves deterministic QoS for high-priority customers.

jiang: alerting: create composite alert when tenant fallback_rate > 5% for 5m AND p95_latency_increase > 30ms. send to oncall and tenant-sli channel.

devon: for product, add a "why did my request use variant X" modal that shows fallback_trace human-readable reasons + a link to request logs and sample outputs used for eval.

kim: one more API thought: expose a query param `?fallback=best-effort|strict|disabled` to allow quick override from SDKs. also ensure server-side policy can override client hints.

marta: excellent. next steps: alex to sketch router pseudocode + sampling ramp plan, jiang to draft telemetry metric set and eval hook spec, devon to wireframe console panels, kim to draft header/query param RFC. I'll collate and send to eng-arch for review.

alex: I'll push initial pseudocode in the design doc later today. sample snippet:
```
if primary.available_slots == 0:
  candidates = find_compatible_variants(primary, region_preference)
  pick = sample_and_score(candidates, sampling_policy)
  route_to(pick)
  emit(fallback_trace)
```

marta: thanks all. trying to avoid making this a heavy ops lift — keep sampling-first and reversible toggles. check back by EOW. :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder: design doc draft due in #design-review on 2024-10-31.
